answer_2.quote: We employ word error rate (WER) to evaluate the intelligibility of the generated speech... Speaker similarity score (SIM) assesses the coherence of the generated speech... F0 Frame Error (FFE) measures the timbre and prosody similarity... We calculate the BLEU score between the generated and the reference text...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a crowd-sourced human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk... we analyze two aspects: style similarity (speaker, emotion, and prosody) and audio quality (clarity, high-frequency), respectively scoring SMOS and MOS.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were instructed to assess audio quality (clarity, high-frequency) and style similarity (speaker, emotion, prosody).
